name: Modular Meddling
description:
Interested in powerful, customizable armor that you can modify as you advance? Look no further than §6§r§l&z&zMechanical Armor§r!

In order to begin tinkering, you'll need a workspace for modifying modular equipment along with a set of Mechanical Armor. The armor is essentially useless on its own, but gains additional features through modification. Each piece of armor is composed of three parts:

§nAugments: §rAugments add a wide variety of useful features to the armor. Augments are categorized into one of three types: §6Protection§r, §aMovement§r, and §dUtility§r. Augments can only be inserted into slots corresponding to their category.

§nFrames:§r The armor's frame determines the protection value of the armor along with how many slots it contains for augments.

§nEnergy Cores:§r The energy core determines how much energy the armor stores, its charging tier, and which augments can be equipped.
